Name: DeadBoy Detectives Butcher Building Reskin
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I went to play [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31888]DeadBoy Detectives[/url] by handwrittenhello, but I use Wayback Pelican Town and the butcher shop clashed way too much for my liking. I got permission from handweitten hello to make a reskin, so here it is!

Simply download the mod and drop it into the DeadBoyDetectives file, and allow to overwrite.

Enjoy!
